selection.ownership: Gem Software, Inc. (US recruiting CRM/ATS; not Greenhouse and not Gem.co crypto)

research.searchCoverage: Bounded 2026-09-13 review of official Gem CRM API v0 reference, help-center API article distinguishing CRM/ATS/Job Board editions, company security/compliance materials, and dated incident search. This is Gem recruiting CRM at gem.com, not Greenhouse and not the unrelated Gem.co crypto API. No qualifying current unresolved incident was identified in reviewed coverage; this is not a breach-free claim.

Official Gem CRM API v0 docs (X-API-Key, https://api.gem.com/v0, page/page_size pagination), help-center article listing CRM vs ATS vs Job Board APIs, company/security pages, and dated incident search on 2026-09-13. Product is the US recruiting CRM at gem.com. Gem ATS and Job Board APIs are a different edition and are not admitted here.

incidents.finding: Published security materials describe SOC 2, TLS, encryption, and incident-response procedures. Bounded search did not identify a current unresolved Gem recruiting-product compromise.
incidents.limitation: This is not a breach-free claim; live authentication remains unverified.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck probes GET /v0/users?page_size=1, matching the pinned validator, and accepts empty input.
Returns the raw Gem JSON array under data. The X-Pagination response header is not mapped. Caller-controlled page is 1-indexed and page_size is bounded to 1–100.
Returns the raw Gem JSON array under data. candidate_ids comma-join and created/updated range filters are omitted because this subset uses only documented page, page_size, and email query names.
candidate_id is percent-encoded as one path segment on GET /v0/candidates/{candidate_id}.
Returns the raw Gem JSON array under data. Optional created-range, owner, and archive filters are omitted from this bounded subset.
POST /v0/candidates. primary_email is adapted into emails[{email_address,is_primary:true}]. created_by is required by the vendor.
PUT /v0/candidates/{id}. Only supplied fields are sent.
DELETE /v0/candidates/{id} with on_behalf_of_user_id. 204 maps to data.deleted.
GET /v0/candidates/{id}/notes.
POST /v0/notes requires candidate_id, user_id, and content.
GET /v0/notes/{id}.
DELETE /v0/notes/{id} returns 204.
GET /v0/projects/{id}.
POST /v0/projects requires name and user_id.
PATCH /v0/projects/{id}.
GET /v0/projects/{id}/candidates.
PUT /v0/projects/{id}/candidates with candidate_ids. 204 maps to data.added.
GET /v0/sequences with optional user_id, sort, page, and page_size.
GET /v0/sequences/{id}.
GET /v0/custom_fields.
GET /v0/custom_fields/{id}.
